description.value:
As a bonus action, you can spend one minute in an unyielding stance. While in the stance, you have advantage on ability checks and saving throws made to shove, trip, or resist being moved, and you ignore difficult terrain. In addition, once per turn when you hit with a melee weapon attack, you may try to shove the target up to 10 feet away from you, with no action required.

The stance ends early if you're incapacitated or killed. You must complete a long rest before using this feature again.
